name: tooth
_: fs-mouth 11-11; format: design C7 (engine/fieldstudio/DESIGN_PRODUCT_2026-11-10.md); optics: engine/materials/profiles + engine/library/mouth/media_fit.json (fitted to cited in-vivo colours); how the renderers read it: fs-light (pending)

rules.what: enamel thickness, U1 labial thirds (cervical / middle / incisal)

medium.fields: one part per tooth (fs-light 20:35): its surface plus true-distance channels 'dej' (= teeth.py Tooth.fields()['dentin']: the DEJ under the crown, the root surface below the CEJ) and 'pulp', on the part's own brick rows, true distance in a band round each zero set, sign-correct inside; saliva a surface coat (n 1.335), not a voxel layer

contact.tooth-gingiva: touch above the sulcus, bond below (junctional epithelium)
contact.tooth-bone: touch across the 0.2 mm periodontal ligament

modifiers.wear: flattens the incisal edge / cusp tips (facets) and lowers the mamelon remnants (form)
modifiers.stain: not yet (colour in the pellicle / enamel cracks, built)
modifiers.age: the incisal mamelons by age and incisal contact (teeth.Tooth: Alalowi & Al-Jhany 2020 prevalence, seeded per incisor)
modifiers.yellowness: per-person tooth yellowness: media_fit.json 'yellowness' (one factor on enamel and dentine absorption above red; whole-tooth b* over the cited in-vivo spread 10.1-17, default 12; the dentine the yellow layer)

levels.sculpt: one albedo per object (Field Studio today)
levels.final: layered media + perikymata relief at render time
